title: Value of a profile gate pair
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices, let $a:\mathbb{N}\to\{−1,1\}$ be a sign sequence, choose a coordinate index $i$, and let $x$ be a sign vector. The sum of the real-valued outputs of the corresponding main and correction gates is $a(i+1)-a(i)$ if $i$ is less than the number of coordinates in $S$ where $x$ equals $1$, and is $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
$i$ is an index in the $n$-dimensional coordinate set
$x$ is a sign vector of dimension $n$
